verdict.rationale: An operating system with built-in AI features could plausibly let users plug in MCP servers, so this story applies to Windows. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or a way to connect external tool servers. The Copilot, Windows AI APIs and AI Foundry toolkit items are adjacent AI features and do not show MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
